<!--
  A post as a card: cover picture, category, title, excerpt, author line and a read link. Axes: layout
  (vertical, horizontal), media (image, none), meta (full, short: the date only, news: date and title only),
  density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Post, PostLabels } from "./post-card.types";

  export type PostCardProps = {
    post: Post;
    labels: PostLabels;
    layout?: "vertical" | "horizontal";
    media?: "image" | "none";
    meta?: "full" | "short" | "news";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Card from "../primitives/card/card.svelte";
  import CardContent from "../primitives/card/card-content.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Link from "../primitives/link/link.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import { defaults } from "../presets/defaults";
  import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    post,
    labels,
    layout = "vertical",
    media = "image",
    meta = "full",
    density = "default",
  }: PostCardProps = $props();
</script>

{#if ((meta as string) === "news")}
  <Box
    class={cn(
      "flex flex-col gap-2 overflow-hidden rounded p-0 inset-ring inset-ring-border",
      defaults.news.card
    )}
    data-testid="item"
    data-layout={layout}
    data-meta="news"
  >
    <Box class={cn("relative shrink-0 overflow-hidden", defaults.news.cover)} data-testid="news-cover">
      <MediaFrame alt={post.title} ratio="16/9" class={cn("size-full", defaults.media.rounded)} />
      <Title
        as={3}
        size="xs"
        weight="semibold"
        class={cn(
          "pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-12 line-clamp-2 text-center leading-5 text-foreground",
          defaults.news.title
        )}
        data-testid="news-title"
      >
        {post.title}
      </Title>
    </Box>
    <Group
      gap="2"
      align="center"
      class={cn("w-full px-2 text-muted-foreground", defaults.news.strip)}
      data-testid="news-date"
    >
      <LucideIcon name="calendar" size={16} />
      <Text size="xs" weight="bold" class="leading-4">
        {post.date}
      </Text>
      {#if post.category}
        <Text size="xs" weight="bold" class="leading-4">
          {post.category}
        </Text>
      {/if}
    </Group>
  </Box>
{:else}
  <Card
    variant="default"
    class={cn(
      "h-full gap-4 overflow-hidden",
      (((layout as string) === "horizontal") ? "flex flex-col sm:flex-row" : "flex flex-col")
    )}
    data-testid="item"
    data-layout={layout}
    data-meta={meta}
  >
    {#if ((media as string) === "image")}
      <Box class={cn("relative shrink-0", (((layout as string) === "horizontal") ? "sm:w-64" : ""))}>
        <MediaFrame alt={post.title} ratio="16/9" class="h-full" />
      </Box>
    {/if}
    <CardContent class="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-2">
      {#if ((meta as string) !== "news")}
        <Group gap="2" align="center">
          <LucideIcon name={post.icon} size={16} />
          <Text size="xs" class="uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            {post.category}
          </Text>
        </Group>
      {/if}
      <Title as={3} size="xl" weight="bold">
        {post.title}
      </Title>
      {#if (((density as string) === "default") && ((meta as string) !== "news"))}
        <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {post.excerpt}
        </Text>
      {/if}
      {#if ((meta as string) !== "news")}
        <Group gap="2" class="mt-auto flex-wrap pt-2 text-muted-foreground">
          {#if ((meta as string) === "full")}
            <Text size="xs">
              {tpl(labels.by, post.author)}
            </Text>
          {/if}
          <Text size="xs">
            {post.date}
          </Text>
          {#if ((meta as string) === "full")}
            <Text size="xs">
              {tpl(labels.minutes, post.minutes)}
            </Text>
          {/if}
        </Group>
      {/if}
      {#if ((meta as string) !== "news")}
        <Link href="#/" variant="default" data-testid="read">
          {labels.read}
        </Link>
      {/if}
    </CardContent>
  </Card>
{/if}
